messages.subject: R-squared in mixed model
parts:
I know Stefan's book doesn't discuss mixed model with the package
lme4, but does anyone know of a way to get the R-squared value for a
mixed model? I didn't see it in Baayen 2008, chapter 7 nor in Bates
2005 (R News article presenting the lme4 package). Maybe I missed it,
or maybe it's not possible. Any ideas? Thanks. Earl Brown
